reply_text:
I saved the draft email to Hollis and replied to Anselm in his DM. Nothing has been sent; someone still needs to send the draft from the drafts folder.

- **Draft:** It goes to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the proposed 2027 rate of $2,101 per seat and says Anselm approved sharing it and that the figure came from Marcus. It also asks Hollis to check with Anselm or June Osei-Lark before passing it on.
- **Approval:** Anselm is the CFO, and finance figures like this rate need his or June's approval before going to anyone else. His message is that approval, so I didn't open a separate approval request. Hollis has an internal pemberline.com address, so Ruth Calloway's sign-off for outside email wasn't needed.
- **Figure:** I used $2,101 as Anselm stated it. I didn't check it against Marcus's original message because that's in Marcus's private DM with me, which Anselm can't see.
